sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《Dealbook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 Dealbook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: For the past few days, Trump allies and Republicans on Capitol Hill have been clamoring for the Attorney General to explain this FBI search of a former president's home.
sentences.zh: 过去几天里，特朗普的盟友和国会山的共和党人一直强烈要求司法部长解释联邦调查局为何搜查一位前总统的住所。

sentences.en: And so Merrick Garland basically said, okay, fine.
sentences.zh: 于是梅里克·加兰基本上说，好吧，行。

sentences.en: You want answers?
sentences.zh: 你们想要答案吗？

sentences.en: I'll show you the warrant.
sentences.zh: 我给你们看搜查令。

sentences.en: Just now, the Justice Department has filed a motion to unseal a search warrant.
sentences.zh: 就在刚才，司法部提交了一份动议，要求公开搜查令。

sentences.en: The warrant revealing that Trump is being investigated for obstruction of justice and violating the Espionage Act.
sentences.zh: 搜查令显示，特朗普因涉嫌妨碍司法公正和违反《间谍法》而受到调查。

sentences.en: Since the raid, Trump's explanations have shifted.
sentences.zh: 自搜查行动以来，特朗普的解释一直在变。

sentences.en: His team now says he had a standing order to declassify documents the moment they were removed from the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 他的团队现在声称，他有一项常设命令，即文件一旦从椭圆形办公室移出，即被视为解密。

sentences.en: As we can all relate to, everyone ends up having to bring home their work.
sentences.zh: 正如我们都能感同身受的那样，每个人最终都难免要把工作带回家。

sentences.en: From time to time, American presidents are no diffity.
sentences.zh: 美国总统也不例外。

sentences.en: The Trump lawyer signed a statement in June saying all classified documents at Mar-a-Lago had been turned over to federal investigators.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的律师在六月份签署了一份声明，称海湖庄园内所有的机密文件都已移交给联邦调查人员。

sentences.en: But that apparently was not the case.
sentences.zh: 但事实显然并非如此。

sentences.en: Sources say investigators are now scrubbing through security footage they subpoenaed from
sentences.zh: 消息人士称，调查人员目前正在仔细审查他们从

sentences.en: Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 海湖庄园传唤来的监控录像。

sentences.en: A tight circle of former Trump White House officials are among those interviewed by the FBI.
sentences.zh: 一小群特朗普白宫前官员也在联邦调查局的受访者之列。

sentences.en: I think this investigation is just getting warmed up.
sentences.zh: 我认为这项调查才刚刚开始升温。

sentences.en: From the New York Times,
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日报道》。

sentences.en: Today, making sense of the latest developments in the case of
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来梳理一下唐纳德·特朗普案件的最新进展，

sentences.en: Donald Trump and the highly classified documents that he stored at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 以及他存放在海湖庄园的那些高度机密的文件。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Maggie Haverman.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事玛吉·哈弗曼。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月18日，星期四。

sentences.en: Maggie, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: I always wondered what it would take to get you on the daily twice in a week, a much desired for possibility.
sentences.zh: 我一直很好奇，要怎样才能让你一周内两次上《每日报道》，这可是个令人向往的可能性。

sentences.en: And it turns out it's the FBI searching the home of the former president.
sentences.zh: 结果是因为联邦调查局搜查了这位前总统的家。

sentences.en: Oh, Michael, thank you for the occasion.
sentences.zh: 噢，迈克尔，谢谢你给我这个机会。

sentences.en: Well, again, you don't have to thank me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，再说一次，你不用谢我。

sentences.en: You have to thank the FBI.
sentences.zh: 你应该去谢联邦调查局。

sentences.en: Since we spoke last with you, Maggie, right after the FBI conducted the search of Mar-a-Lago,
sentences.zh: 玛吉，自从我们上次和你交谈，也就是联邦调查局对海湖庄园进行搜查之后，

sentences.en: there has been a lot of new developments, most of them broken by you and our colleagues.
sentences.zh: 出现了许多新进展，其中大部分是由你和我们的同事率先报道的。

sentences.en: So we want to talk through those developments and make sense of them because it's still a pretty confusing story, I think, for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想梳理一下这些进展并理清头绪，因为我认为对很多人来说，这仍然是一个相当令人困惑的故事。

sentences.en: So I want to start with the nature of the documents that FBI agents found at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 我想先从联邦调查局在海湖庄园发现的那些文件的性质谈起。

sentences.en: What do we know specifically about these documents?
sentences.zh: 关于这些文件，我们具体了解些什么？

sentences.en: So, Michael, there were several boxes of documents, other pieces of paper and so forth, taken from Mar-a-Lago during this search.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，在这次搜查中，从海湖庄园带走了几箱文件、其他纸张等等。

sentences.en: According to the inventory that was made public last week, there were 11 sets of documents with classification markings on them.
sentences.zh: 根据上周公开的清单，其中有11套文件带有密级标记。

sentences.en: So there's
sentences.zh: 所以有

sentences.en: TS, which means top secret, the highest classification.
sentences.zh: TS，意思是绝密，是最高密级。

sentences.en: Then there's TS-SCI, which is an abbreviation for top secret sensitive compartmented information.
sentences.zh: 然后是 TS-SCI，这是“绝密敏感隔离信息”的缩写。

sentences.en: And what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: So SCI is a separate security clearance process that runs through the CIA.
sentences.zh: SCI 是一个通过中央情报局进行的独立安全审查程序。

sentences.en: That suggests an even narrower group of people who would have access to those pages.
sentences.zh: 这表明只有极少数人能够接触到这些页面。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So the kinds of documents that are reserved for the absolute highest levels of government, really the most sensitive kind of information that there is.
sentences.zh: 所以这些文件是留给政府最高层级的，确实是目前存在的最敏感的信息。

sentences.en: That is exactly correct.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Maggie, among these documents that you just described, do we know any specifics about what kind of secrets they contained?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，在你刚才描述的这些文件中，我们是否知道它们具体包含什么样的秘密？

sentences.en: What kind of words were on the page?
sentences.zh: 页面上写了些什么词？

sentences.en: We only know, Michael, certain descriptors of specific pieces of information that they took, the FBI took.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我们只知道联邦调查局带走的特定信息的一些描述符。

sentences.en: So for instance, there's one document marked info related to the president of France.
sentences.zh: 例如，有一份文件标记为“与法国总统有关的信息”。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We don't know what that is.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: We know that in another case, something related to his clemency grant toward Roger Stone, his longtime advisor, was there as well.
sentences.zh: 我们知道在另一个案例中，还有一些与他对他长期顾问罗杰·斯通的减刑有关的内容。

sentences.en: But in terms of the classified material that had these markings on them, it could be anything.
sentences.zh: 但就带有这些标记的机密材料而言，它可能包含任何东西。

sentences.en: And I do mean anything.
sentences.zh: 我是说真的，任何东西。

sentences.en: There has been a lot of questions about the range of secrets that he had access to and might have taken with him.
sentences.zh: 关于他能接触到并可能带走的秘密范围，一直有很多疑问。

sentences.en: We also know from our reporting that at least during the course of the last roughly 18 months, when federal officials were trying to get these documents
sentences.zh: 我们从报道中还了解到，至少在过去大约18个月里，当联邦官员试图取回这些文件时，

sentences.en: back, they were said to contain material that was part of special access prograMs.
sentences.zh: 据说其中包含属于“特殊访问计划”的材料。

sentences.en: That is very, very, very sensitive information with real access restrictions.
sentences.zh: 那是极其、极其敏感的信息，有着严格的访问限制。

sentences.en: And that could be a lot of different things related to weapon systems, related to a number of other items that most
sentences.zh: 这可能涉及很多不同的东西，比如武器系统，以及其他许多大多数

sentences.en: government officials would not want to see outside the government.
sentences.zh: 政府官员不希望在政府之外看到的内容。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's been speculation that those programs might include nuclear prograMs. Do we know if that's true?
sentences.zh: 有人猜测这些计划可能包括核计划。我们知道这是真的吗？

sentences.en: We don't know that.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: That has not been confirmed.
sentences.zh: 这一点尚未得到证实。

sentences.en: The idea that it could contain materials related to nuclear programs does not necessarily mean weaponry specifically.
sentences.zh: 它可能包含与核计划有关的材料，并不一定意味着具体指武器。

sentences.en: It's a range.
sentences.zh: 范围很广。

sentences.en: It also doesn't mean it's necessarily about U.S.
sentences.zh: 它也不一定是指美国的

sentences.en: nuclear prograMs. It could be a foreign country's nuclear programs or nuclear capabilities or development.
sentences.zh: 核计划。它可能是指外国的核计划、核能力或核开发。

sentences.en: Again, it's a very, very broad range, but we have not confirmed that.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，范围非常、非常广泛，但我们尚未证实这一点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So let's turn to what we're learning about the lengths that the Department of Justice and the
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们谈谈我们所了解到的司法部和

sentences.en: National Archives went before this FBI search to get these documents.
sentences.zh: 国家档案馆在这次联邦调查局搜查之前为获取这些文件所做的努力。

sentences.en: You referred to an 18-month period.
sentences.zh: 你提到了一个18个月的周期。

sentences.en: I want to further explore what occurred during that period, because I know you found a lot of new information about that.
sentences.zh: 我想进一步探讨这一时期发生了什么，因为我知道你发现了许多关于此的新信息。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So, Michael, at some point in 2021, the National Archives realized that it was missing material.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，2021年的某个时候，国家档案馆意识到丢失了材料。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Last week, we talked about the efforts to get back 15 boxes of material in January of 2022.
sentences.zh: 上周，我们谈到了2022年1月为取回15箱材料所做的努力。

sentences.en: Since then, we have learned that there was a grand jury that was impaneled to investigate this, ultimately issuing a subpoena in May for these documents.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，我们了解到有一个大陪审团被召集来调查此事，并最终在5月份对这些文件发出了传票。

sentences.en: It's a pretty severe step to have to take.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当严厉的举措。

sentences.en: It's pretty telling, because subpoenas get issued when you'd think that other methods have not worked.
sentences.zh: 这很能说明问题，因为当你认为其他方法都行不通时，才会发出传票。

sentences.en: And so a subpoena was issued to try to force this.
sentences.zh: 所以为了强制执行，发出了传票。

sentences.en: And right before a planned meeting on June 3rd between two of Trump's lawyers and a top counterintelligence official at the Justice Department's National
sentences.zh: 就在6月3日特朗普的两名律师与司法部国家安全司的一位高级反间谍官员举行计划会议之前，

sentences.en: Security Division, one of those lawyers, Evan Corcoran, is said to have gone through the boxes to try to identify the material the DOJ wanted.
sentences.zh: 据称其中一位律师埃文·科科兰翻阅了这些箱子，试图找出司法部想要的文件。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Evan Corcoran and this other lawyer, Christina Bob, met with these officials on June 3rd,
sentences.zh: 埃文·科科兰和另一位律师克里斯蒂娜·鲍勃在6月3日会见了这些官员，

sentences.en: handed over a sheaf of material with classified markings, and signed a statement, at least one
sentences.zh: 交出了一叠带有密级标记的材料，并签署了一份声明，至少其中一人签署了声明，

sentences.en: of them signed a statement, saying that material found in those boxes had been returned, essentially leaving DOJ with the impression, this is it.
sentences.zh: 称箱子里发现的材料已经归还，基本上让司法部产生了一种印象：这就是全部了。

sentences.en: This is all of it.
sentences.zh: 这就是所有东西。

sentences.en: Okay, let me just establish where we are in the timeline here.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我先梳理一下这里的时间线。

sentences.en: Trump has returned the 15 boxes.
sentences.zh: 特朗普归还了15箱文件。

sentences.en: The government suspects there's still more documents left at Mar-a-Lago that they want.
sentences.zh: 政府怀疑海湖庄园里还有他们想要的文件。

sentences.en: They're not getting them back.
sentences.zh: 他们没能拿回来。

sentences.en: And so they issue a subpoena.
sentences.zh: 于是他们发出了传票。

sentences.en: And now there's a negotiation about getting them.
sentences.zh: 现在关于获取这些文件还有谈判。

sentences.en: That's kind of where we are in the story you're telling.
sentences.zh: 这就是你所讲述的故事目前的进展。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And an assurance, Michael, that they have the material they were seeking on June 3rd.
sentences.zh: 而且，迈克尔，他们还保证在6月3日已经交出了他们所寻求的材料。

sentences.en: That's key.
sentences.zh: 这一点很关键。

sentences.en: After that, the Justice Department gets some witness testimony indicating that there may be additional material at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，司法部得到了一些证人证词，表明海湖庄园可能还有额外的材料。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They then, on June 22nd, subpoena surveillance footage from the club.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们在6月22日传唤了该俱乐部的监控录像。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Not just, but including the outer area outside of the storage room in the basement where these boxes, at that point, were being kept.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是，但也包括了地下室储藏室外面的区域，当时这些箱子就存放在那里。

sentences.en: And what do they find in that surveillance video?
sentences.zh: 他们在监控录像中发现了什么？

sentences.en: So, they see something that alarms them.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了一些让他们感到不安的东西。

sentences.en: The footage was for a 60-day period.
sentences.zh: 录像涵盖了60天的时间。

sentences.en: And it shows, again, this outer area outside this room where there's a lot of traffic.
sentences.zh: 它显示了那个房间外面的区域，人流量很大。

sentences.en: There are a lot of people coming in and out during this 60-day period when the Justice Department is in touch with Trump's team.
sentences.zh: 在司法部与特朗普团队接触的这60天里，有很多人进进出出。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And this raises concerns for them.
sentences.zh: 这引起了他们的担忧。

sentences.en: And I assume the concern is we've got classified documents at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 我猜担忧的是：我们有机密文件在海湖庄园。

sentences.en: They're not being returned, and they're definitely not secure because people are going in and out of this room.
sentences.zh: 它们没有被归还，而且绝对不安全，因为人们进进出出这个房间。

sentences.en: That's what the surveillance video is revealing.
sentences.zh: 这就是监控录像所揭示的内容。

sentences.en: At minimum, Michael, that is what the surveillance video is revealing.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，至少监控录像揭示的就是这些。

sentences.en: And that's what they're concerned about.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们所担心的。

sentences.en: They are worried, at minimum, that there are more documents remaining there.
sentences.zh: 他们至少担心那里还有更多的文件留存。

sentences.en: And we don't know why there were still these additional documents and why they were left behind.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道为什么还有这些额外的文件，也不知道为什么它们被留下了。

sentences.en: But clearly, after seeing the video, the Justice Department decided that it couldn't take assurances that everything was being safely dealt with.
sentences.zh: 但显然，在看了录像后，司法部认为不能再相信一切都会得到妥善处理的保证。

sentences.en: And all of this, as we understand it, formed the basis for the probable cause that led to this extraordinary search warrant on August 8th.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，所有这些构成了导致8月8日那份非同寻常的搜查令的合理根据。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And those include, correct me if I'm wrong, Maggie, active resistance from Trump, a lawyer of his incorrectly stating that all the documents had been returned, surveillance tape
sentences.zh: 其中包括——如果我说错了请纠正我，玛吉——特朗普的积极抵制，他的律师错误地声称所有文件都已归还，以及监控录像

sentences.en: showing this space where the documents are isn't secure.
sentences.zh: 显示存放文件的空间并不安全。

sentences.en: So overall, what we're seeing is what looks like some level of not just resistance from the Trump world, but deception when it comes to these documents.
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，我们看到的不仅是特朗普阵营某种程度上的抵制，在这些文件的问题上，似乎还存在欺骗行为。

sentences.en: That's what the government has observed before they start searching the place.
sentences.zh: 这就是政府在开始搜查之前所观察到的情况。

sentences.en: That, Michael, as we understand it, is the Justice Department's position that they believed they were not being told the truth.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，据我们了解，司法部的立场是他们认为自己没有被告知真相。

sentences.en: And it was more than just an inadvertent slip.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是无意的疏忽。

sentences.en: It was more than just not knowing the full scope of what was there, that they had tried and tried and tried and had been trying to work with Trump's team and been given assurances.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是不了解那里到底有什么，而是他们尝试了又尝试，一直试图与特朗普的团队合作，并得到了保证。

sentences.en: And those assurances turned out to be false and that they couldn't let this go on any longer.
sentences.zh: 但这些保证被证明是虚假的，他们不能再让这种情况继续下去了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So this is all the background that unfolded in a very unseen way by the public before the FBI and
sentences.zh: 所以这就是在联邦调查局和

sentences.en: the Department of Justice reach the conclusion that they need to go there with agents and search this place, get these documents.
sentences.zh: 司法部得出结论，认为需要派遣特工去搜查那个地方并取回这些文件之前，公众所未见的全部背景。

sentences.en: There was an enormous amount of backstory here before they got to the point of executing a warrant, which is
sentences.zh: 在他们执行搜查令之前，有大量的背景故事，这是一个

sentences.en: an extraordinary step in which the Justice Department has acknowledged was an extraordinary step to take against a former president.
sentences.zh: 非同寻常的步骤，司法部也承认，对一位前总统采取这种行动是非同寻常的。

sentences.en: But it was because they felt they had tried everything else and they were not being told the truth by Trump's team and that there was more in terms of documents
sentences.zh: 但这是因为他们觉得已经尝试了所有其他方法，却没有从特朗普团队那里得到真相，而且还有更多

sentences.en: that were sensitive and that were related to national security that were at Mar-a-Lago, not clearly secured, and that needed to be retrieved.
sentences.zh: 敏感且与国家安全相关的文件留在海湖庄园，显然没有得到妥善保护，必须取回。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡，去探索《纽约时报》的内容，那会怎样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以做到了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 这一个月的时间，你可以越过付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅者每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载这款应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So as you said, Maggie, all this backstory is what leads us to a search warrant and to an actual search at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 所以正如你所说，玛吉，所有这些背景故事最终导致了搜查令的签发，以及对海湖庄园的实际搜查。

sentences.en: When we spoke with you last week, we didn't really have any information about that search warrant.
sentences.zh: 我们上周与你交谈时，对那份搜查令其实并没有什么了解。

sentences.en: Now we do.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道了。

sentences.en: So what does the warrant tell us about what exactly the Justice Department was worried about and what legal grounds they used to conduct this very unusual search?
sentences.zh: 那么，这份搜查令向我们揭示了司法部究竟在担心什么，以及他们以何种法律依据进行了这次非常罕见的搜查？

sentences.en: So, Michael, there were three criminal statutes that were cited in the warrant.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，搜查令中引用了三项刑事法规。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: One related to obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 一项与妨碍司法公正有关。

sentences.en: One related to mishandling of records.
sentences.zh: 一项与不当处理记录有关。

sentences.en: And the third, which caught a lot of us by surprise, was the Espionage Act.
sentences.zh: 而第三项，也是让我们许多人感到惊讶的一项，是《间谍法》。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think obstruction and mishandling of documents makes a certain amount of intuitive sense,
sentences.zh: 我认为妨碍司法和不当处理文件在直觉上是说得通的，

sentences.en: given everything that you have just told us about the president's resistance to giving the documents back.
sentences.zh: 考虑到你刚才告诉我们的关于总统拒绝归还文件的一切情况。

sentences.en: But can you explain the role of the Espionage Act here and how that might apply to the circumstances we're discussing?
sentences.zh: 但你能解释一下《间谍法》在这里的作用，以及它如何适用于我们正在讨论的情况吗？

sentences.en: The Espionage Act, Michael, is a very old law.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，《间谍法》是一部非常古老的法律。

sentences.en: It goes back to 1917 during World War I.
sentences.zh: 它要追溯到1917年第一次世界大战期间。

sentences.en: And what it does is it criminalizes the unauthorized retention or disclosure of information related to national defense that could harm the United States or aid its enemies.
sentences.zh: 它的作用是将未经授权保留或披露与国防有关的信息的行为定为犯罪，因为这些信息可能损害美国或帮助其敌人。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Now, a president has never been charged with violating this act before.
sentences.zh: 此前从未有总统被指控违反该法案。

sentences.en: And we don't know yet if Trump or anyone around him will be charged.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道特朗普或他身边的人是否会被起诉。

sentences.en: But the thinking is that Trump taking these documents to Mar-a-Lago or someone sending them to Mar-a-Lago with Trump is a violation of the rules around retention and mishandling of sensitive government documents.
sentences.zh: 但人们认为，特朗普将这些文件带到海湖庄园，或者有人将这些文件与特朗普一起送到海湖庄园，违反了有关保留和不当处理敏感政府文件的规定。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Just so I understand, it's not under this law just illegal to share state secrets, which is, I think, how many of us think of the word espionage.
sentences.zh: 为了确保我理解正确，根据这项法律，不仅仅是分享国家机密是非法的——我想我们许多人对“间谍”一词的理解就是这样。

sentences.en: It's also under this law illegal just to possess them if you're not authorized to do so or if you haven't handled the documents in the right way.
sentences.zh: 根据这项法律，如果你没有获得授权，或者没有以正确的方式处理文件，仅仅是持有它们也是违法的。

sentences.en: That's how this might apply to Trump in theory.
sentences.zh: 这就是它在理论上可能适用于特朗普的方式。

sentences.en: That is exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Okay, so this brings us to a claim that Trump made in the past few days, which is that he had set up a system, he said, of automatically declassifying documents as president.
sentences.zh: 好的，这引出了特朗普在过去几天里提出的一个说法，即他曾设立了一个制度，他说，作为总统，他可以自动将文件解密。

sentences.en: And I believe his defense here is, by the time these documents got to Mar-a-Lago, they're no longer classified.
sentences.zh: 我相信他在这里的辩护是，当这些文件到达海湖庄园时，它们已经不再是机密了。

sentences.en: Therefore, what's the big deal and why on earth are you searching my house?
sentences.zh: 因此，这有什么大不了的？你们为什么要搜查我的房子？

sentences.en: What do we make of that claim, Maggie, that as President Trump had established this automatic declassification system?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，我们该如何看待特朗普总统建立了这种自动解密系统的说法？

sentences.en: So, as somebody who covered the Trump White House, Michael, I had never heard of this claim before.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，作为一名报道特朗普白宫的记者，我以前从未听说过这种说法。

sentences.en: And I asked several former officials about it, and they hadn't either.
sentences.zh: 我问过几位前官员，他们也没听说过。

sentences.en: There's no evidence to support this claim.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据支持这一说法。

sentences.en: John Bolton, Trump's third national security advisor, told me he himself was never briefed on such a system when he came into the government.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的第三任国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿告诉我，他进入政府时，从未收到过关于此类系统的简报。

sentences.en: He never heard of it in his 17 months there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里的17个月里从未听说过。

sentences.en: He never heard of it after from any of his colleagues with whom he was still in touch.
sentences.zh: 他后来从仍有联系的同事那里也从未听说过。

sentences.en: And he told me that he thought it was almost certainly a lie.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他认为这几乎肯定是谎言。

sentences.en: If anyone has seen this standing order, I am unaware of it, and therefore it is not clear that it's actually true.
sentences.zh: 如果有人见过这项常设命令，我并不知情，因此不清楚它是否真实存在。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay, well, even if this standing order did exist, which it sounds like in many people's minds it didn't, would it matter to the legal questions at hand?
sentences.zh: 好吧，即使这项常设命令真的存在——听起来在许多人看来它并不存在——它对当前的法律问题有影响吗？

sentences.en: So, our colleague Charlie Savage has looked at this question, and Charlie knows these issues and the issues around classification in and out.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事查理·萨维奇研究过这个问题，查理对这些问题以及围绕机密级别的问题了如指掌。

sentences.en: And his point has been that the question of whether these documents were classified or not is actually irrelevant to any potential charges that Trump or people around him could be facing.
sentences.zh: 他的观点是，这些文件是否属于机密，实际上与特朗普或他身边的人可能面临的任何潜在指控无关。

sentences.en: The three criminal statutes that are mentioned in the warrant, obstruction, mishandling of documents, and the Espionage Act,
sentences.zh: 搜查令中提到的三项刑事法规：妨碍司法、不当处理文件和《间谍法》，

sentences.en: they don't require the documents to have classified markings.
sentences.zh: 它们并不要求文件必须有机密标记。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, even in the case of the Espionage Act, which is, you know, concerned specifically with secrets of the state, it just needs to be considered sensitive information.
sentences.zh: 是的，即使是《间谍法》，你知道，它专门针对国家机密，它只需要被视为敏感信息即可。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, it's not really about the classifications on the document.
sentences.zh: 所以，这实际上与文件上的机密级别无关。

sentences.en: It's about the fact that they feared these were the kinds of documents that, if they got into the wrong hands, would present a threat to the United States.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，他们担心这些文件如果落入坏人之手，会对美国构成威胁。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Maggie, is the Department of Justice claiming that Trump did anything wrong with these documents during all this time?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，司法部是否声称特朗普在这一过程中对这些文件做了什么不当行为？

sentences.en: Or is this just about a theoretical fear that he might at some point do something wrong with documents, share them with somebody who was a spy for an agent, so on?
sentences.zh: 还是说这仅仅是出于一种理论上的担忧，即他可能在某个时候对文件做了什么错事，比如把它们分享给间谍或特工等等？

sentences.en: What we know the federal government has alleged, Michael, is that they wanted documents back and couldn't get them.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我们所知道的是联邦政府声称他们想要回这些文件，但无法得到。

sentences.en: And it may end there.
sentences.zh: 事情可能就此结束。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: We don't know if there is something broader, but there have been some clues from the Justice Department that there is something broader.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是否有更广泛的情况，但司法部确实透露了一些迹象，表明事情可能更复杂。

sentences.en: Such as?
sentences.zh: 比如？

sentences.en: Well, they've done a number of interviews with current Trump aides who would have some visibility into whether documents were still at the property and what he was doing with them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们对现任特朗普助手进行了多次采访，这些人能够了解文件是否还在庄园里，以及他用这些文件做了什么。

sentences.en: But also, former senior Trump White House officials who had direct knowledge of how documents were handled.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有直接了解文件处理方式的前特朗普白宫高级官员。

sentences.en: And they've clearly tried gleaning insight into what was going on with Trump and these documents over a long period of time.
sentences.zh: 他们显然试图深入了解特朗普和这些文件在很长一段时间内的情况。

sentences.en: So, the Justice Department was clearly afraid that Trump could do exactly what you just said, share them, let somebody access them through carelessness,
sentences.zh: 所以，司法部显然担心特朗普会做出你刚才说的那种事，分享它们，或者因为粗心大意让别人接触到它们，

sentences.en: put the federal government at risk by doing so.
sentences.zh: 从而使联邦政府面临风险。

sentences.en: And that it could be with some knowledge of what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 而且这可能是在他知情的情况下发生的。

sentences.en: But to be fair, Trump is somebody, as I told you last time we talked about this, who has a long history of loving tchotchkes and showing them off to people.
sentences.zh: 但平心而论，正如我上次谈到这个话题时告诉你的，特朗普是一个有长期爱好收藏小摆件并向人炫耀的人。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: there is a world where these were things he took as some kind of personal keepsake because he refuses to see them as the government's property and that it was less nefarious than it was obstinate.
sentences.zh: 有一种可能，这些东西是他作为某种个人纪念品拿走的，因为他拒绝将它们视为政府财产，这与其说是邪恶，不如说是固执。

sentences.en: But for the federal government, that doesn't matter that much.
sentences.zh: 但对联邦政府来说，这并不重要。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I do wonder what the federal government would think of you describing a top secret document as tchotchke, but...
sentences.zh: 我确实想知道，如果联邦政府听到你把一份绝密文件描述为“小摆件”，他们会怎么想，但是……

sentences.en: I'm sure there are many, many, many national security officials, current and former, who would take issue with that.
sentences.zh: 我相信有许多许多国家安全官员，无论是现任还是前任，都会对此提出异议。

sentences.en: But that's how he would see it.
sentences.zh: 但这就是他眼中的样子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, at the end of the day, this 18 months of the government asking for this stuff, it's very possible that he's simply resisting all of that, essentially,
sentences.zh: 所以归根结底，政府花了18个月的时间索要这些东西，他很可能只是在抵制这一切，本质上，

sentences.en: for the sake of what amounts to a classified scrapbook.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是为了保留一份所谓的“机密剪贴簿”。

sentences.en: That's an excellent phrase, Michael.
sentences.zh: 这是一个绝妙的短语，迈克尔。

sentences.en: You should patent that.
sentences.zh: 你应该去申请专利。

sentences.en: And yes, that may indeed exactly be what this is, that this is somebody who liked the things that he got his hands on.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实可能就是真相，这就是一个喜欢自己弄到手的东西的人。

sentences.en: This is somebody who has always focused on other people's secrets and thought he had secrets from the government that he thought were cool and could hang on to them.
sentences.zh: 这是一个一直关注他人秘密的人，他认为自己掌握着政府的秘密，觉得这些秘密很酷，所以想把它们留住。

sentences.en: So, Maggie, where does this story go next?
sentences.zh: 那么，玛吉，这个故事接下来会如何发展？

sentences.en: What are you still trying to understand here?
sentences.zh: 你还在试图弄清楚什么？

sentences.en: It's only been a week.
sentences.zh: 才过去一周而已。

sentences.en: There's still a lot of elements at play.
sentences.zh: 还有很多因素在起作用。

sentences.en: Among the key issues, Michael, beyond what was in the documents, the nature of them, just how sensitive they were,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，关键问题之一，除了文件里有什么、它们的性质、它们到底有多敏感之外，

sentences.en: did they contain specific references to very potentially scary secrets?
sentences.zh: 它们是否包含对某些潜在可怕秘密的具体提及？

sentences.en: More about the timeline, exactly how long these negotiations were going on, exactly what they entailed,
sentences.zh: 还有更多关于时间线的问题，这些谈判到底进行了多久，具体涉及什么，

sentences.en: and whether the government ultimately is truly considering bringing charges against a former president or any of his aides in connection with this.
sentences.zh: 以及政府最终是否真的在考虑就此事对一位前总统或其任何助手提起诉讼。

sentences.en: That's my question.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的问题。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it's my biggest question in all of this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这是我对此最大的疑问。

sentences.en: Is it possible that this entire saga ends with the government getting the documents back, being grateful, and moving on?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能整个事件的结局是政府拿回了文件，表示感谢，然后继续前进？

sentences.en: Or do they have a bigger legal strategy that is more punitive in mind?
sentences.zh: 还是他们心中有一个更具惩罚性的法律策略？

sentences.en: I don't think they're ever going to feel grateful about how this all went down, Michael, but it certainly could end with them having the documents back, exhausting interviews,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我不认为他们会对这一切的发生感到感激，但结局确实可能是他们拿回了文件，完成了详尽的采访，

sentences.en: and other methods of investigation, and deciding that's that, and moving on from this.
sentences.zh: 以及其他调查方法，然后决定到此为止，不再追究。

sentences.en: But it's way too soon to say.
sentences.zh: 但现在下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: Well, until next time, hopefully within another week.
sentences.zh: 好吧，期待下次再见，希望在一周之内。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，玛吉。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Our party stands with the men and women who serve on the thin blue line at the federal and state and local level.
sentences.zh: 我们党支持在联邦、州和地方各级维护治安的男男女女。

sentences.en: And these attacks on the FBI must stop.
sentences.zh: 这些对联邦调查局的攻击必须停止。

sentences.en: In a speech on Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 在周三的一次演讲中，

sentences.en: former Vice President Mike Pence called on Republican officials to stop attacking law enforcement agencies like the FBI and the Department of Justice for searching Donald Trump's house for classified documents.
sentences.zh: 前副总统迈克·彭斯呼吁共和党官员停止攻击联邦调查局和司法部等执法机构，因为他们搜查了唐纳德·特朗普的房子以寻找机密文件。

sentences.en: His remarks appeared to be aimed above all at congressional Republicans, some of whom have called for the destruction and defunding of the FBI in the wake of the search,
sentences.zh: 他的言论似乎主要是针对国会共和党人，其中一些人在搜查后呼吁解散和削减联邦调查局的经费，

sentences.en: and was the latest sign that Pence is distancing himself from the Trump wing of the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 这也是彭斯正在与共和党内的特朗普派系保持距离的最新迹象。

sentences.en: And the head of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said that the agency has failed to effectively respond to the COVID pandemic and would undertake a major set of reforMs.
sentences.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心负责人表示，该机构未能有效应对新冠疫情，并将进行一系列重大改革。

sentences.en: Many of those reforms will focus on ensuring that the CDC issues clear and fast guidance to the public,
sentences.zh: 其中许多改革将集中于确保疾控中心向公众发布清晰、快速的指导意见，

sentences.en: rather than the sometimes confusing and contradictory guidance that characterized its response to COVID.
sentences.zh: 而不是像其应对新冠疫情时那样，有时会出现令人困惑和矛盾的指导意见。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko and Will Reed.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科和威尔·里德制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett, fact-checked by Susan Lee, contains original music by Dan Powell and Rowan Emisto, and was engineered by Corey Shreppel.
sentences.zh: 由佩奇·考特编辑，苏珊·李核实事实，包含丹·鲍威尔和罗文·埃米斯托的原创音乐，并由科里·施雷佩尔进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
